description:
### Kizu 2.0.1-beta.28

- Starts composer discovery from Twitch Activity lifecycle before chat-message binding, with layout-aware retries as a fallback for late-inflated chat inputs.
- Warms the bundled Twitch-native emote catalog and global provider catalogs early; local native prefix matches do not wait for network catalog requests.
- Reuses the horizontal PopupWindow and updates strip contents/position in place instead of dismissing and recreating it for every keystroke or provider/image update.
- Adds elapsed-time diagnostics for Activity/root discovery, listener attachment, first text change, native and merged prefix matching, and first strip display.
- Experimental testing pre-release. Stable v2.0.0 remains unchanged.
